 traffic-shape rate 1536000 6144 0

!
interface Serial0/1
 ip address 203.0.113.9 255.255.255.252
 custom-queue-list 2
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
 rate-limit input access-group 101 2000000 375000 750000 conform-action transmit exceed-action drop
 rate-limit input 8000000 1500000 3000000 conform-action transmit exceed-action set-prec-transmit 0
!
access-list 101 permit ip 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255 any
access-list 110 permit ip any host 198.51.100.10
priority-list 1 protocol ip high list 110
priority-list 1 protocol ip medium tcp 23
priority-list 1 queue-limit 30 40 50 60
queue-list 2 protocol ip 1 list 110
queue-list 2 protocol ip 2 udp 5060
queue-list 2 default 3
queue-list 2 queue 1 byte-count 3000 limit 30
queue-list 2 queue 3 byte-count 1500
